reviews_h2: What people are saying about the landscaping

reviews.author: Ariana Rose
reviews.text: Their team is absolutely fantastic. We have worked with them multiple times and their quality is consistent and always exceeding our expectations. Its a pleasure working with them and results always make us happy. Just a few before and after pictures but the entire property looks manicured. I'm a terrible picture taker and these are just some of many. Totally thrilled!

reviews.author: Kay Kartechner
reviews.text: My husband and I are very happy with our new patio and landscaping. The pavers are beautiful and expertly installed. The landscaping crew completed the project efficiently and planted all trees exactly as requested. Joseph came back after all trees and shrubs were planted to ensure all were doing well. I now have more landscaping planned with Mercer Group LLC to complete the border around the backyard and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a local landscaper that does excellent work.

reviews.author: Christina L
reviews.text: We are very happy with the fantastic job Mercer Group Landscaping did for our residence. Joe and Ash are wonderful communicators that truly made the process very simple and easy for us. Our residence had a large rotted out old deck that we had removed and when we discovered there was old broken/sunken concrete underneath we needed to do something. Joe was amazing from start to finish with the project. The crew did a fantastic job and we are very happy with our new concrete patio. We would highly recommend Mercer Group Landscaping and would hire them again for any other jobs we may have in the future. Communication is so important and Joe and Ash stayed on top of communication. Thank you all for getting our yard to be transformed into a safe area for our family to enjoy!

reviews.author: Jeremy Fox
reviews.text: We were completely overwhelmed with Virgina Creeper and quickly found out that my whole family is severely allergic to the plant. Joe and his team responded within minutes of me sending an email. They came out and handed everything so we wouldn't have to go anywhere near the plants. They were prompt and professional and their work speaks for itself!

reviews.author: Alejandra Jurado
reviews.text: Joe and his team did a great job with our backyard! Very courteous and professional, as was Ash when communicating with us if we had any questions. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Jeep Guy
reviews.text: By far the BEST Spring clean up we’ve had in 10 years. This was more of a deep cleaning of our landscaping then a spring clean up and I truly can’t believe it. Thank you Joseph Le and Mercer Group Landscaping. The transformation of our property was extraordinary and we are grateful.

reviews.author: Nick Pirone
reviews.text: My wife and I were referred to Joe through close friends when looking for a hardscape contractor. Out of the 3 companies we received quotes from our experience with Joe was the best from start to finish. While his pricing wasn’t the lowest, we knew his attention to detail would be reflected in planning and executing the job. His communication, punctuality and execution were top notch and his crew were all so pleasant. Look no further when planning your patio or walkway project.

reviews.author: Rose Romaine
reviews.text: We have been wanting to update our front yard for a couple of years and decided to hire Mercer Group Landscaping. We didn’t want a “cookie cutter” design and they gave us what we wanted. I will definitely be using them again when we do our back patio

reviews.author: Sarah Yake
reviews.text: Oh my gosh, if I could give more than five stars I would!! Joe and is team are absolutely incredible. My husband and I had an overwhelming amount of trimming and weeding that needed to be done- within just a few hours our yards were totally transformed. So detailed and efficient. A great experience from start to finish!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Eric F
reviews.text: The entire Mercer Group team (back office, foreman, crew) was fantastic. They came promptly for the estimate, gave a fair price, executed when the said they would, and did a great job. Everyone was friendly and professional. My yard looks amazing; I can't believe they did so much in just one day! Thanks Joe and team!

reviews.author: Jim K
reviews.text: I recently contacted Mercer Group Landscaping to have them do a clean-up of the garden area around my rear patio and to put down fresh mulch. From the beginning, Joe and Ashley were very responsive, and a pleasure to work with. My project was scheduled quickly, and the final result looks wonderful! I really appreciate the great job done by Joe and his team. I highly recommend Mercer Group to anyone needing landscaping work to be done!

reviews.author: Michelle Manella
reviews.text: This is the 2nd year we’ve worked with Mercer Group Landscaping and we love their work! Joe is very easy to communicate with the entire process From estimate to the day of work. The crew does a wonderful job and everything turned out exactly as planned. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great company to work with on landscaping needs!

reviews.author: erica rauch
reviews.text: We had Mercer Group Landscaping redo the landscaping in our backyard. From the first call, the owner Joe was kind and courteous and listened to what we envisioned for our backyard. They planted a mix of evergreen and flowering trees and shrubs that will give us a beautiful backyard all spring and summer. The workers were clean and efficient and left our property looking pristine. We will use Mercer Landscaping again and again! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: I recently moved and needed a cleanup of heavy brush and overgrown garden beds. Mercer Group was very responsive, followed up with a reasonable estimate, and got the job scheduled quickly. Joe and his team did great, thorough work and I would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Genn Hellerstedt
reviews.text: Joe and his team are miracle workers! He's so nice and really took the time to explain his whole plan for my yard to make it look it's best. They're always on time and they work so quick. I wish I had before pictures to be able to explain the INSANE difference they have made. The amount and quality of work they do for the price can't be beat honestly. Everything turned out so much better than I could have imagined.

reviews.author: Megan McCloskey
reviews.text: Mercer Group Landscaping has come through for me and my friend time and time again! Their commitment to their clients is unmatched. From general landscaping and clean ups to stunning hardscapes and patios, Mercer Group does exceptional work and they pride themselves on their honesty, reliability & quality. Personally, the professionalism, responsiveness, quality of work, and friendliness of those who work for the company are just a few of the reasons why I feel so confident recommending them to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Rex Parker
reviews.text: We hired Mercer Group Landscaping in July 2021, to trim a large boxwood hedge around our front yard in Hopewell Twp. Joseph (owner operator) got us on the schedule promptly and arrived on time as planned. He and the crew were very professional and did an excellent job trimming the hedge. Work was completed within a couple hours and they did a nice job cleaning up afterwards. We would highly recommend Mercer Group Landscaping for residential horticultural and other jobs. Top rate company.

reviews.author: Scott Rubin
reviews.text: Great experience with Mercer Group. The price was right in line with other companies. But their expertise was superior to any other company. I hadn't had a cleanup in two years so it was a big job. They were able to do everything in a single day. The landscaping looked perfect once they were done.

reviews.author: Shana Williams
reviews.text: Their goal is “to leave every customer satisfied” and that is exactly what they do! Joe and his crew are friendly and reliable and their work is outstanding! They take pride in building relationships with their clients and reach out often to ensure that their customers are satisfied! I love the fact that someone is ALWAYS available to address your needs…..they are just a phone call away! They always go above and beyond!!!!! Need a landscaper? Look no more……Mercer Group Landscaping never disappoints!

reviews.author: matthew kugel
reviews.text: The crew was quick and efficient. They disposed of refuse, disposed of overgrowth, filled holes dug by our dog, and cleaned our gutters. In six hours they transformed our front lawn and back yard to states not seen in years. We were very pleased with the experience.

reviews.author: Alison Browne
reviews.text: I am very pleased and satisfied with the work Joe and his team did for my landscaping. Joe was very responsive and listened to my requests. I would definitely use them again and would suggest them to anyone looking to have a landscape project.

reviews.author: James Page
reviews.text: When I needed estimates for damage to my property recently, Joe from Mercer group was responsive and on top of EVERYTHING. The group was easy to contact and answered all of my questions. The estimate covered all things my lawn needed to be restored to its original condition and Joe kept his word to provide prompt service. We would give six stars if there was a 6 star rating.

reviews.author: Cinthya Swen
reviews.text: Joe and his team came out for a spring cleaning of our backyard. They did a great job and was extremely responsive and professional! We will definitely use their services again!

reviews.author: Gianna Bigliani
reviews.text: Beautiful professional work! It's not just about making your lawn beautiful, their knowledge about plants, soil, patio materials and aesthetics comes together for a lasting result! Thank you for making my friend's home feel like a paradise!

reviews.author: Peter Barbera
reviews.text: I recently had the opportunity to sit through a hardscaping/paver presentation given by the owner, Joseph. He was not only extremely knowledgeable on the subject, but had a genuine love for the business of both hardscaping and landscaping. Having worked with other contractors in the past, I now know why their work did not stand the test of time. Joe and his team do not cut corners and they do that job the "right" way every single time, no matter the circmunstances. Most other landscape contractors will cut corners to maximize their profits...not these guys! My one comment to Joe after his presentation was that I wish I knew him 10 years ago before I went with one of those contractors that just cut corners, which is costing me $$$ in yearly repairs and maintenance. Get your work done right the first time and call Mercer Group Landscaping!!!

reviews.author: Ryan Lindsay
reviews.text: We've hired Joe twice and both times have been amazing. Great with communication and has a very clean, tidy and efficient team. We'll definitely be using him again in the future.

reviews.author: Kristen Sullivan
reviews.text: Highly recommend Mercer Group Landscaping. This summer they installed vinyl fencing for us and today they excavated an area of our property so we can fully access our driveway and garage. Joe is easy to work with and highly responsive.

reviews.author: Daniel Leon Jr.
reviews.text: Mercer Group Landscaping did a nice quality job laying pavers and setting up the pitch for drainage. The owner was straightforward, answered all my questions & addressed any concern I had. They left the place clean after the project was completed.... I will contract them again for any future landscaping project & highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Fred Ewig
reviews.text: If you're looking for a professional company to come and update your exterior landscaping, you should reach out to Mercer Group Landscaping. Joseph and his team will make sure that all details are covered, both in the planning stages and the actual build out. I would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Matt Padd
reviews.text: The team at Mercer Group Landscaping was top notch. Joseph was responsive and professional. The quality product and service he and his team delivered was exceptional. I would absolutely recommend this group.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Peterson
reviews.text: Joe and his team are great. He is very knowledgeable and provided a great plan to clean up the landscaping at our house. Everything looks fantastic and we will definitely be calling them again.

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.text: Joe is fantastic! He is very friendly and they have great prices! Mercer Group Landscaping does a tremendous job. They are always on time and do a terrific job with the yard.

reviews.author: Rich Schumacher
reviews.text: Reasonable prices, high-quality and fast work, and easy communication make these guys a great choice. Initially hired for a simple weekly lawn cut, I've since had them take care of other things since it's so easy. I've always found it hard to find reliable landscapers but Mercer Group is the best.

reviews.author: Dean Gittleman
reviews.text: I have hired Mercer Group Landscaping for various landscaping-related work on my house since I moved in a year and a half ago. I have always found it easy to work with them. They have always done good work, highly professional. I plan to hire them for a major landscaping project later this year.

reviews.author: Steph Stripp
reviews.text: 100% give my stamp of approval for Mercer Group Landscaping! We had a great experience with Joe and his team who were able to extend our concrete patio just in time for Memorial Day (woohoo!).

reviews.author: Bob Wernik
reviews.text: Joseph and his team have provided excellent service, and a level of professionalism that is above and beyond. The planning and execution of all lawn work, planting, and tree removal have been amazing! Thank you Joseph

reviews.author: Brad Smith
reviews.text: Joe and his group were quick to take over lawn care for us and they have been timely and have great attention to the details. Will definitely recommend to others! They added landscaping for us that came out great as well. Thanks!

reviews.author: John Tran
reviews.text: It was a pleasure working with Joe and his team. Needed to weed, trim and mulch my house. He was willing to work within my budget. Friendly, honesty, professional, communicate and delivered ask promise. Will work with him again.

reviews.author: Erica Gavzy
reviews.text: This group is absolutely amazing. They totally transformed the look and feel of our yard after it got completely out of control. Prices were fair, and they are an excellent group of professionals to work with. Absolutely recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Sarah Flynn
reviews.text: Excellent experience! A rain storm was coming up so they called to reschedule to an earlier date! Team did a great job cleaning up our front and back yard.

reviews.author: Elieth Valverde
reviews.text: Joe and Mercer Group are incredible. I had a few companies come out and they were by far the most detailed. Making recommendations and completing our patio project.

reviews.author: Michele Musci
reviews.text: Joe and his team are professional and reliable. They turned our overgrown weeds and neglected garden beds into pristine beauty! So grateful, and can’t wait to have Joe back for more work!

reviews.author: Donald W
reviews.text: Had some landscaping and gutter work done by this group. They were thorough and efficient and the job was beautifully done. Cleanup was immaculate. Joseph is a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Victor cordero
reviews.text: Recently purchased a new home and the yard had massive tree stumps needing removal. The guys were on time, professional and knocked it out in a day, they even offered clean up service which I strongly recommend taking if you need this done to your yard.

reviews.author: Tom David
reviews.text: Joseph and his team did an amazing job!!!! From start to finish it was pleasure to work with them. Thank you very much! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Kelly Sullivan
reviews.text: Very good work - my yard looks great ! Responsive and professional- I would recommend. They checked my shrubs and treated for aphids I did not know I had

reviews.author: iSlapWhalez
reviews.text: Mercer Group Landscaping was impeccable and their attention for detail while re-mulching my yard during this years Spring Clean Up, made me a lifelong customer. Would recommend to anyone looking!

reviews.author: Ted Simpson
reviews.text: Joseph loves this stuff, and it shows in his work and how he treats us as customers. He answers the phone - he's there when he says he will be there - his projects are first rate and fair priced. And he guarantees his work.

reviews.author: Jacques Vaval
reviews.text: Mercer Group Landscaping are very Professional, they’re an elite group in their profession, and their prices are great!!! I’m glad I chose them to do my Landscaping and more! You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Joann D
reviews.text: Very professional. I love the fact that when I call I always speak with someone . Their work is very good and the workers are so nice and always go beyond just cutting the grass . They actually pulled the weeds which was way beyond their job (they were outside by my plants) I would definitely recommend them You won’t be disappointed !

reviews.author: Isabela Siqueira
reviews.text: We were so amazed by Joe and his crew! This was our first home and we had big projects to get some landscaping and paving done I couldn’t be happier with the results! Thanks team

reviews.author: Lena Mansah Barnes
reviews.text: Joe and his team did an awesome job with my lawn. I called him just yesterday, he managed to come today and did his best to clean and fix my lawn. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Rich Silverman
reviews.text: Very happy we chose Mercer Group for our walkway/front steps repair. The price was fair, and the work was timely and looks great.

reviews.author: Steph Capella
reviews.text: They were a breeze to work with! They responded to my calls immediately (unlike other companies) and were very reasonably priced. Their work was great.

reviews.author: Alexis Antracoli
reviews.text: This was a great experience. Joseph got back to me right away with a reasonable price and the work was done extremely well. I would definitely hire again.

reviews.author: David Hallgren
reviews.text: Mercer Group Landscaping the best!! They worked fast and hard the whole time they were at our house. The curb appeal of our place is exponentially better!

reviews.author: David Adler
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Mercer Group. They did a lot of work ata good price and really tamed our mess of a yard.

reviews.author: James Zaremski
reviews.text: Prompt, courteous, professional. Beautiful hardscaping workmanship. Quality of work far exceeded expectations and cost.

reviews.author: Craig Zee
reviews.text: Responsive and professional. Followed up promptly with any questions we had and moved quickly. Recommended.
